title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Division of Work for Petition Review and Retrial of Administrative Cases
keywords_en: Application for Retrial; Supreme People's Court Regarding Administrative Cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Division of Work for the Review of Petitions and Retrial of Administrative Cases

Fa Fa [2012] No. 18

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

In order to further standardize the division of work for the review of petitions and retrial of administrative cases by the People's Courts, and to improve the quality and efficiency of administrative adjudication, the following notice is hereby given on the relevant issues:

For cases concerning administrative petitions and applications for retrial, where, upon examination by the Case Filing Division, the conditions for filing and reviewing the case are satisfied, once the case is filed, the Administrative Adjudication Division of the People's Court at each level shall be uniformly responsible for the review and retrial. The review of petitions and retrial work regarding cases in which a ruling was made to dismiss the lawsuit shall be the responsibility of the Case Filing Division. Where a party files a petition or applies for retrial with the People's Court that rendered the effective judgment or ruling, and the conditions for filing and reviewing the case are satisfied, once the case is filed, the Adjudication Supervision Division shall be responsible for the review and retrial.

This Notice shall take effect as of January 1, 2013. Cases that have not been concluded by that date shall continue to be handled by the original trial department.

It is hereby notified.

August 31, 2012
